notes: Seventeen source and twenty-seven target tokens each partitioned once.
בִּהְיוֹת לָכֶם is rule 43's pattern exactly: הָיָה carries the have, the possessive לְ is left with nothing and goes unrepresented under rule 40, and the suffix takes the subject pronoun ye.

הוֹתַרְתִּי → will I leave a remnant heads on remnant by rule 44's subtraction test, with the indefinite a going to that nominal under rule 15; heading on leave is defensible if the rendering is read as one lexical verb plus object.
Both temporal בְּ + infinitive clauses take their subordinator on the preposition under rule 52 — in that and when — while the suffix on the second infinitive takes its subject ye under rule 18.
